text: ノーマル　みず　くさ…　わざマシンにも　タイプが　あるんだ　これをみて　あいしょうの　よさそうな　ポケモンに　おぼえさせてみよう！

structure.jp: ノーマル　みず　くさ…
わざマシンにも　タイプが　あるんだ
structure.en: TMs have types too, you see

structure.jp: あいしょうの　よさそうな　ポケモンに
structure.en: to Pokémon that seem a good match
let's try having them learn it!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone do it; the one who does it gets に. ポケモンに　おぼえさせて = 'have a Pokémon learn it'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる means 'try doing it and see', and the よう ending adds 'let's'. おぼえさせてみよう = 'let's try having them learn it'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (seems)
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'looks like it is'; いい turns into よさそう, with な in front of a thing. あいしょうの　よさそうな　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that looks like a good match'.
